translations.web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
translations.bsb: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?
translations.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
translations.asv: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
